QuestInfo.name: [Ludibrium] Wild Toy Horses
QuestInfo.1: At the request of #b#p2040003##k, eliminate 100 #r#o3230305##k monsters. #o3230305# can be found in #b#m220010000##k and #b#m220011000##k.

0.0: Ah, long time no see! I remember our adventures with the teddies and toys...good times. I'm on to a new campaign these days, the #bToy Trojan Reformation campaign#k. Ah, I've seen that expression before... You MUST be interested!

yes.0: Good, good. #r#o3230305##k, my allies, have started turning on people. I mean, they were always a bit violent...it's their nature, after all. But this is too much. That's why I'm spearheading my campaign. Can you fight a #r#o3230305##k? 'Cause I need you to beat 100 of them.

no.0: Dang it. After all we've been through together...

yes.0: I hope that this violence will change the hearts of the violent Toy Trojans...
